title: Cairn configuration, version 1
description: Named repositories and workflows. Runtime loading and execution are delivered separately; see docs/configuration.md.

version.description: Required configuration schema version; never inferred.

repositories.description: Named existing Borg repositories. An empty map is allowed.

workflows.description: Named procedures, optionally scheduled. An empty map is allowed.

lockWait.description: Borg lock-acquisition timeout in seconds, not a task timeout. Zero does not wait.

location.description: Existing local repository or native Borg SSH location, never an archive. Local relative paths use the config directory; ~ and ~/ expand locally.

passphrase.description: Literal secret, including an explicitly empty passphrase. Mutually exclusive with passphrase_file. Never expand or log this value.

passphrase_file.description: Passphrase file, relative to the config directory; ~ and ~/ expand. Mutually exclusive with passphrase.

identity_file.description: SSH identity file, relative to the config directory; ~ and ~/ expand. Only valid for SSH repositories.

cron.description: Optional cron schedule. Omit for manual-only execution. Cron dialect and timezone semantics are settled in issue #55.

stages.description: Run in order; advance only if all tasks in the previous stage succeeded without warnings.

tasks.description: Run concurrently. Let siblings finish after a warning or failure, then stop the workflow.

repository.description: Name of a repository defined in repositories, not its location.

archive_prefix.description: Append Cairn's UTC timestamp. Borg placeholders remain unchanged. Mutually exclusive with archive_name.

archive_name.description: Exact archive name, with native Borg placeholders; no timestamp is added. Mutually exclusive with archive_prefix.

source_root.description: Borg working directory. Defaults to the config directory. Relative paths use that directory; ~ and ~/ expand.

sources.description: Native Borg source arguments, unchanged. Relative paths use source_root, not Cairn's invocation directory.

repository.description: Name of a repository defined in repositories, not its location.

archive_prefix.description: Select PREFIX-* using native Borg placeholders and glob semantics. Matching exact-name archives are also in scope.

keep_within.description: Positive integer followed by H, d, w, m, or y, using Borg interval semantics.

keep_secondly.description: Borg retention count: zero disables, negative means unlimited periods.

keep_minutely.description: Borg retention count: zero disables, negative means unlimited periods.

keep_hourly.description: Borg retention count: zero disables, negative means unlimited periods.

keep_daily.description: Borg retention count: zero disables, negative means unlimited periods.

keep_weekly.description: Borg retention count: zero disables, negative means unlimited periods.

keep_monthly.description: Borg retention count: zero disables, negative means unlimited periods.

keep_yearly.description: Borg retention count: zero disables, negative means unlimited periods.

repository.description: Name of a repository defined in repositories. Compaction is repository-wide and needs no encryption key or passphrase.
